error.title: Something is not working
error.body: Nothing you saved has been lost. Try again; if it still fails, come back in a few minutes.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page was moved or deleted.

offline.title: You are not connected to the internet
offline.body: EventDesk needs the internet to show you up-to-date information. Everything you saved is safe.

incident.title: Something is not working
incident.default: Something is not working as it should right now. We are fixing it, and your data is safe.

errors.csrf: The request did not come from the app. Reload the page and try again.

upload.empty: The file is empty. Choose another file.
upload.tooLarge: The file is too large. The limit is 10 MiB per file.
upload.type: We only accept PNG or JPG images.
upload.typeWithPdf: We only accept PNG or JPG images and PDF documents.
upload.unreadableImage: We could not read the image. Save it again as PNG or JPG and try once more.
upload.infected: The file was rejected by the security check and was not saved.
upload.scanUnavailable: We cannot check files right now, so nothing was saved. Try again in a few minutes.
upload.overLimit: You have reached the {limit} limit for files. The largest file is “{asset}” ({assetSize}). Delete it or another one, then upload again. We deleted nothing.
upload.overLimitField: There is no room left for this file. Delete an existing file first.
upload.overLimitEmpty: The file does not fit within the {limit} limit.
upload.directUnavailable: Direct upload is not available. Use the upload form.
upload.unknownPurpose: This kind of upload is not available.
upload.hintImages: PNG or JPG, 10 MiB at most.
upload.hintWithPdf: PNG, JPG or PDF, 10 MiB at most.
upload.failed: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
